did.abstract: A collection of ephemera from the 75th anniversary of Time magazine in 1998, including the invitation and program from the 75th anniversary gala and commemorative gifts given to gala attendees.
did.physloc: Materials in this collection may be stored offsite. For more information on making arrangements to consult them, please visit www.nyhistory.org/library/visit.
did.langmaterial: The documents in the collection are in English.

bioghist.head: Biographical / Historical
bioghist.p: Time is a news magazine that has been published in New York since 1923. This collection is from the 75th anniversary of the magazine in March 1998.

accessrestrict.head: Access Restrictions
accessrestrict.p: Materials in this collection may be stored offsite. For more information on making arrangements to consult them, please visit www.nyhistory.org/library/visit.

userestrict.head: Use Restrictions
userestrict.p: Application to use images from this collection for publication should be made in writing to: Department of Rights and Reproductions, The New York Historical, 170 Central Park West, New York, NY 10024-5194, rightsandrepro@nyhistory.org.

prefercite.head: Preferred Citation
prefercite.p: The collection should be cited as: Time 75th anniversary ephemera collection, MS 3269, The New York Historical.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: This collection documents the celebration of Time's 75th anniversary in 1998. It includes an invitation to Time's 75th anniversary gala on March 3, 1998, addressed to Amelia Weiss, as well as her table assignment card and gala program. The rest of the collection consists of 75th anniversary commemorative gifts, including notecards of famous Time covers, anniversary issues of Time and related publications, and a book about Time's magazine covers.

relatedmaterial.head: Related Materials
relatedmaterial.p: The New York Historical holds the records of Time, Inc., the parent company of Time magazine. An overview of the Time Inc. Records is available online.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p:
Collection includes the following:
• Invitation (with enclosures) to the Time 75th anniversary gala on March 3, 1998, addressed to Amelia Weiss
• Table assignment card for Amelia Weiss
• Program for the Time 75th anniversary gala held on March 3, 1998 at Radio City Music Hall
• 75th anniversary notecards (10) featuring Time covers, in a commemorative box
• Faces of Time: 75 Years of Time Magazine Cover Portraits (Boston: Little, Brown and Co., 1998), in 75th anniversary slipcover
• Four-flap enclosure including:
• Time 75th Anniversary Issue, vol. 151, no. 9, March 9, 1998
• Time for Kids, vol. 3, no. 10, February 27, 1998
• Facsimile of the first issue of Time, vol. 1, no. 1, March 3, 1923
• Covering History: Time Magazine Covers 1923-1997
